meta.name: canvas-design
meta.description: Create beautiful visual art in .png and .pdf documents using design philosophy. You should use this skill when the user asks to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static piece. Create original visual designs, never copying existing artists' work to avoid copyright violations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 根据描述生成原创视觉设计图片和PDF文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成原创海报、艺术图或静态视觉设计。
copy.tagline_en: Create original visual art and PDF documents from descriptions.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly generate original posters, artwork, or static visual designs.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你的输入创建一份设计哲学（.md 文件），然后生成一张视觉海报（.png 或 .pdf）。它强调极简文字、空间构图和手工质感，作品看起来像大师精心打磨的艺术品。
howto.when: 当你要求制作海报、艺术作品、设计或其他静态视觉内容时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一张极简主义海报，主题是“城市孤独”。
say.note: Claude 会先创建设计哲学，再生成海报。

say.text: 为我的咖啡品牌做一张艺术感强的宣传图。
say.note: Claude 会围绕品牌调性生成视觉作品。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude creates a design philosophy (.md file) based on your input, then generates a visual poster (.png or .pdf). It emphasizes minimal text, spatial composition, and handcrafted quality, making the output look like a masterpiece by a top expert.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create a poster, piece of art, design, or other static visual content.

say_en.text: Design a minimalist poster about 'urban loneliness'.
say_en.note: Claude will first create a design philosophy, then generate the poster.

say_en.text: Create an artistic promotional image for my coffee brand.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a visual piece aligned with the brand's vibe.
